facts.text: I lost my old favorite water bottle on a road trip to the mountains.
I drove 200 miles to reach the mountains on the first day of my road trip.
My old water bottle was made of stainless steel.
My old water bottle had insulation.
My old water bottle was around 27 oz in size.
I liked the durability of my old insulated stainless steel water bottle.
My old water bottle kept my drinks cold for hours.
I decided to go with Hydro Flask.
I chose the Hydro Flask Standard Mouth 24 oz water bottle.
I like the Hydro Flask Standard Mouth 24 oz because it is a classic choice and easy to carry.
I went on a 4-day road trip to the mountains with my family.
We drove around 200 miles each way on the road trip.
We stopped at 3 different scenic spots along the way.
On the second day, we hiked for about 5 miles to reach a beautiful waterfall.
I completed the hike without too much trouble.
I am not exactly an avid hiker.
I want to explore more hiking spots in the Pacific Northwest.
I want hiking spots around Oregon or Washington.
